Finish a log

Source: R/logging.R
finish_log.Rd

Logs the current date and time and session info, and switches logging off.

Usage

finish_log()

Value

None, the function is invoked for its side effect.

See also

init_log, log_text

Examples

finish_log()
#> INFO [2025-10-15 07:26:04] Finished analysis. Wed Oct 15 07:26:04 2025
